title: WIST Label Definition Envelope (WIST-2 §3.3)
description: A Labeler's signed definition of one Label Registry name it uses: where the name's meaning is described and the treatment a Consumer applies by default (WIST-4 §6). Served by the Labeler, never sealed. The name's registry form beyond its syntax, the description's normalization and the key binding are WIST-2 §3.3 and WIST-1 checks the schema cannot make.

wist_version.description: Release-version spelling only. WIST-1 sections 3.1 and 7 separately require supported-major validation; minor and patch differences alone do not reject.

labeler.description: Signed Labeler identity, bound as a Catalog's `publisher` is under WIST-1 section 3.8; must equal its own Canonical Host. The pattern alone does not validate A-labels.

name.description: `<prefix>:<term>` from the Label Registry (WIST-4 §6), the name this definition is about.

description.description: A Normalized URL (WIST-1 section 2), byte-identical to its own normalization, where the Labeler describes what the name means and how it is applied.

treatment.description: The treatment a Consumer applies to labeled subjects when its own profile names none (WIST-4 §6).

asserted_at.description: The instant the definition is asserted for, read exactly as an Item's `observed_at` (WIST-1 section 3.4); the newest definition a Consumer verifies is the one it reads.
